Welcome to Body Mechanics Orthopedic Massage, where expert hands meet science-backed techniques to provide the best prenatal, sports, medical, and deep tissue massage therapy in Manhattan, New York. Our licensed massage therapists specialize in personalized treatments designed to relieve pain, improve mobility, and support overall wellness. We offer deep tissue, Swedish, sports, prenatal, postnatal, TMJ, lymphatic drainage, post-op, post-mastectomy, cupping, and therapeutic massage, plus yoga therapy to relieve pain, improve mobility, and support recovery. Visit us at 34th & 54th Street for personalized, results-driven care.
